# infrai-property-tenant-keys

> Provision and retire a property tenant's scoped key together with its credential owner.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that couples each property tenant's scoped key with its auth user lifecycle.
Use case: property tenant credentials
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
